title: Brookfield Seeks Around $800 Million Loan for World Freight LBO

title: Stocks Fall on War, Credit Woes as Brent Tops $100: Markets Wrap
content: A renewed oil spike stoked fears the war in Iran will further crimp energy supplies and fuel inflation, spurring a slide in stocks, which were also hit by signs of distress in the $1.8 trillion private-credit market.

title: Iran's Strait Closure Drives Oil Higher | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 3/12/2026
content: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec speak with Bloomberg Economics chief geoeconomics analyst Jennie Welch on the impact on global energy markets as Iran's supreme leader says that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed. Then, Skyler Weinand, chief investment officer at Regan Capital, discusses market reaction to escalations in the conflict. Plus, Jason Greenblath, senior portfolio manager at American Century Investments, discusses the credit landscape as Amazon drives corporate bond sales to a record single-day high. Finally, Myles Miller gives an update on a shooting at synagogue in West Bloomfield, Michigan. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Polish President Vetoes Plan to Tap Defense Loans From EU
content: Polish President Karol Nawrocki said he won’t sign a legislation designed to give his country a quick access to €43.7 billion ($50.3 billion) from the European Union’s loans-for-weapons program in a blow to pro-EU government.
